description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made to amend the order published in Gazette Ex. Ord. No. 1999/23 of 27.12.2016 under section 3 of Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989 by a substitution
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an amendment to an existing excise law (Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989) through a ministerial order. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake by name and title, it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities but rather focuses on the regulatory amendment to excise rates, making it a legal/regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid type.
